site.name: M/V HONDIUS
site.desc: UNOG confirmed evacuation complete 11 May; all passengers and crew disembarked Tenerife, repatriation underway across 23 nations. ECDC reports 9 total cases (7 confirmed, 2 probable) monitored aboard; vessel en route Rotterdam with 30 skeleton crew + Dutch nurse for full decontamination.

site.name: PARIS / LE BOURGET
site.desc: First confirmed hantavirus case in France: one of five repatriated Hondius passengers tested PCR-positive 11 May (Le Monde); condition worsening overnight, strict isolation at Bichat Hospital Paris. French government mandated 42-day quarantine decree with contact tracing identifying 22 potential cases across international flights.
